title: leucanthemum vulgare subsp. maximum
intro: Leucanthemum vulgare subsp. maximum, commonly known as Maximilian's Daisy or Ox-eye Daisy, is a perennial plant species within the daisy family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation and fighting off infections due to its antibacterial properties. The therapeutic actions of Leucanthemum vulgare subsp. maximum include its use in treating various conditions such as fever, coughs, and respiratory issues, as well as its ability to act as a diuretic. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
